item: SYS INSERTLINE / INSLINE insert bag field by index
title: SYS INSERTLINE|INSLINE bag n value insert 0-based field
summary: SYS INSERTLINE|INSLINE|INSERTFIELD bag n value insert field at 0-based index. n>=count appends, n==0 front, n<0 soft miss. LAST_N=field count. Completes PUSH/PREPEND/SETLINE for ordered work bags. selftest 72.
